factory_document: Philco 1941 RMS Year Book, printed page 38, schematic diagram for PT-42/PT-44

verified_external_conductor_groups.title: Second IF secondary low to volume control top
verified_external_conductor_groups.basis: Factory page 38: secondary lower terminal descends to #16 track upper lug and #15 250 pF upper side.

verified_external_conductor_groups.title: Volume-control wiper to coupling capacitor
verified_external_conductor_groups.basis: Factory page 38: wiper arrow terminates at left side of #18 0.01 µF; crossing vertical lines do not have junction dots.

verified_external_conductor_groups.title: 7C6 triode grid and grid leak
verified_external_conductor_groups.basis: Factory page 38: right side of #18 and upper end #19 connect to 7C6 triode grid lead.

verified_external_conductor_groups.title: Detector audio passive common return
verified_external_conductor_groups.basis: Factory page 38: #15, #16, #17 and #19 lower terminals share detector return; this does not establish a chassis bond.

verified_external_conductor_groups.title: Upper second-IF secondary and AVC load
verified_external_conductor_groups.basis: Factory page 38: upper #14 secondary joins the upper 7C6 diode glyph lead and #17 upper terminal. The glyph is not assigned to pin 5 or 6.

spice_limit: SPICE draft can include #15/#18/#19 passive devices but does not infer a valid detector or automatic volume control behavior.

verified_schematic_symbol_connections.basis: Philco 1941 RMS p.38: the upper end of the second IF secondary, upper end of #17, and the upper diode plate glyph share the drawn conductor. The factory symbol does not label the 7C6 socket pin.
